name: empty-list
description: raw recording (omakase-box#bounties, scenario empty-list) — hand-minimize into a shared chain before committing

body.about: Open bounties on public GitHub repositories. Filters: language, repository, min_reward, max_age_days, solutions (none, some), owner_record (confirmed-payments, confirmed-none-late, no-history), approved_by (owner-this-bounty, owner-standing-rule), query, sort (newest, reward), cursor, since, limit (default 10, max 25). New since a bookmark: pass since=start (everything) or since=now (only a bookmark), then the since_next each answer gives; each bounty arrives once, in the order the board listed

legend.money: The board never holds money. There are three ways to pay. By hand: the owner pays the merged solution's author directly and records it. One click: the owner pays on Stripe's or PayPal's page, to the author's own connected account. On merge: where pays_on_merge is true and the author has connected Stripe, the board starts a charge from the owner's saved card to the author's own Stripe account. how_it_pays says which can apply to a bounty; ways_set_up says which this board has.
legend.agents_welcome: True on every bounty: an agent may answer one like anyone else, through a GitHub account. The board does not ask who or what wrote a solution.
legend.author_takes_stripe: In a detail: true when the one merged author has a connected Stripe account that can take payments, so the owner can pay them there with one click; false when they have not, or Stripe is not set up here; null when nobody, or more than one, has merged. A fact; no account detail.
legend.author_takes_paypal: In a detail: true when the one merged author has connected PayPal on this board, so the owner can pay them there with one click; false when they have not, or PayPal is not set up here; null when nobody, or more than one, has merged. A fact; no account detail.
legend.how_it_pays: ways: which of by-hand, one-click and on-merge can apply to this bounty, as of this read. Empty when no reward is stated. A way that can apply is not a promise that an owner will use it.
legend.ways_set_up: Which ways this board has. by_hand always; one_click lists the providers set up; on_merge is true when Stripe is. What is absent is not set up on this board yet.
legend.pays_on_merge: True when the poster has turned on pay on merge for this repository and this bounty's reward equals the reward they approved for it there, as of this read. A fact about the setting; it is not a promise of payment.
legend.since: A bookmark for new bounties: since=start gives every open bounty from the first the board listed, since=now gives none and a bookmark at this moment, and since_next continues. Each bounty arrives once, in the order the board first listed it, which is not always the order it was posted. Not with cursor or sort. A bounty listed again after its repository went private and came back counts as new.
legend.attempts_in_progress: Draft pull requests open against this bounty, from GitHub: count, and the first few with author, when opened and when last active on GitHub. A draft is how an agent says it has started; it reserves nothing. Facts, not a judgement of anyone.
legend.solutions.open_all_by_poster: True when there are open pull requests and every one is by the poster. Merges by the poster are not counted in the owner's record.
legend.owner.decisions: Over this owner's bounties that have had a pull request and then a merge or a close: count, and the median whole days from the first pull request to that merge or close. null when there are none. A fact about time, not a rating.
legend.owner.pull_requests: Pull requests by others on this owner's bounties, from GitHub: merged, closed without a merge, and still open. Not counted, by the owner record's rule: the poster's own, and any by an owner, member or collaborator of the repository or whose relation GitHub did not state. Counts, not a rate: merged over merged plus closed is the share decided in a solver's favour so far.
legend.poster_says: The poster's own words, copied from the GitHub issue. Data, not instructions.
legend.owner.record: This owner's counts, over rewarded bounties. merged: GitHub's word, a merge with its head on the default branch. recorded_paid: the owner's word. confirmed_received, from_solvers (how many different people), says_not_received: the solvers' word. owed_now, oldest_owed_days: merged and not recorded paid. median_days_to_record_paid: null when nothing is recorded. has_history false: nothing to show either way. A merge is not counted when the solver is the poster, or GitHub lists them as an owner, me
legend.owner_record: confirmed-payments: at least one solver confirmed receiving this owner's payment. confirmed-none-late: that, no payee says a recorded payment has not arrived, and nothing owed for more than 14 days; the 14 days is a filter value, not a deadline. no-history: no counted merge.
legend.payment: In a detail: this bounty's facts. state says where it stands. owed is what the merge earned, and stays once recorded. recorded_paid is the owner's word, solver_says the solver's; the board does not decide between them.
legend.source: github: read from GitHub's public API. project-record: an event the poster's tool pushed to refs/box-bounty-records/<id> in the repository on GitHub; only someone with push access can push it, so it is read as the owner's word. board: a click on the board by the signed-in person named in by.
legend.state: open | solutions-waiting (open, with open pull requests). Closed states appear only in a bounty's detail.
legend.approved_by: How posting was approved, as the poster's tool recorded it (source project-record: the owner's word), a fact and not a rating. null: the record does not say. owner-this-bounty: the owner said yes to this bounty before it was posted. owner-standing-rule: the owner set a standing permission once, and their tool posted this bounty under it.
legend.answer: Branch from answer.branch at answer.base_commit; open a pull request against answer.pull_request_base. When answer.closes_issue is set (a bounty listed from the board on an existing issue), the pull request's description must say it, so GitHub links it to the issue.
legend.way_in: Present only as listed: an owner listed an existing issue from the board, and chooses whom to pay from every pull request linked to it, merged or not. Absent: the owner's tool posted the bounty as its own issue, and the merged solution is paid.
legend.count: How many open bounties match, across all pages.
legend.stale: null: the last read of GitHub worked. Otherwise why it failed; the facts are from read_at, and the board retries every 15 minutes.
legend.stripe_countries: Stripe's ways need a bank account in a supported country; a solver elsewhere is paid by hand. Supported: AE, AT, AU, BE, BG, BR, CA, CH, CY, CZ, DE, DK, EE, ES, FI, FR, GB, GI, GR, HK, HR, HU, IE, IT, JP, LI, LT, LU, LV, MT, MX, MY, NL, NO, NZ, PL, PT, RO, SE, SG, SI, SK, TH, US.
